heroBody: Critical alerts from Grafana, UptimeRobot, and HTTP webhooks can be missed as push or email. WakeUp Dev turns them into phone calls and requires human acknowledgement—press 1 to ACK. If nobody responds, the on-call cascade escalates automatically. Start free with 5 voice alerts via GitHub.
howItWorksBody: Send a POST from Grafana, UptimeRobot, or any HTTP monitoring system to WakeUp Dev. WakeUp Dev calls the on-call responder and waits for a human acknowledgement. If nobody acknowledges the alert, the on-call cascade continues.
ackSectionTitle: Don't just notify. Get a human acknowledgement.
ackSectionBody: Traditional notifications tell you something happened. WakeUp Dev is designed for incident response where someone needs to actually respond. A phone call can provide a more direct notification when someone may not be watching their usual alert channels; press-1 ACK confirms a human received the alert before the cascade moves on.
pagerDutyLine: WakeUp Dev is designed as a lightweight voice-first alternative for teams that need critical alerts to reach a human—not a full replacement for every on-call platform.
integrationsMention: Works with Grafana, UptimeRobot, HTTP webhooks, and your existing on-call roster for DevOps and SRE incident response.
authRequired: Sign in with GitHub to open the dashboard or subscribe to the Chile plan.

modelTitle: Classic on-call platforms do not scale with your squad
modelBody: Adding a DevOps engineer should not open another line on the invoice. WakeUp Dev charges for usage: unlimited users, price tied to dispatched alert volume.
compareOurs1: Unlimited users in the same workspace
compareTheirs1: An extra charge for every engineer you add to on-call
compareOurs2: You pay for the alerts that actually get dispatched
compareTheirs2: A per-seat subscription, even when the month is quiet
compareOurs3: TwiML voice call with Gather and digit-1 ACK
compareTheirs3: Push, email, and Slack; no TwiML call or digit-1 ACK
pricingTitle: Automated on-call cascade. CSV roster/shifts with atomic replace.
pricingSubtitle: Trial, Basic, Pro Chile, and International Pro. GitHub to get in. Transbank in Chile. Lemon Squeezy worldwide.

planEntBody: For large companies, payment gateways, and teams with dense infrastructure.
planEntFeat1: More than 1,000 contracted monthly phone alerts
planEntFeat2: Volume discount and flat infrastructure rate

planEntFeat4: Priority support and a dedicated channel with SLA
